title: Hand Foot Self-Massage
summary: The thumb and palm gently work the sole and heel.
goal: Relax the foot gently after walking or standing.
startingPosition: Sit comfortably and support the foot.
instructions: Stroke the sole from heel to toes.
Add small circles over the arch.
direction: From heel to toes and over soft areas of the sole.
warning: Stop self-massage with pain, numbness, weakness, dizziness, radiating sensations, or other unusual symptoms.
